verdict.rationale: Deepgram's docs show several mechanisms that together enable per-call personalization — Settings-time prompting (docs-7), a conversation-context API with mid-call agent message injection (docs-11, docs-23), and reusable agent configs referenced by UUID (docs-4, docs-21) — but there's no explicit documented feature for templated dynamic variables (e.g. {{caller_name}}) substituted into the prompt/context at connection time. Missing for 10: explicit variable/templating syntax for injecting per-caller data into the Settings message, and a worked example showing caller-specific personalization end-to-end.
